title: Movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player
observed: Tick 'pause+right' from a fresh game: mode becomes paused (pause menu open), but the player moves (1,1) -> (2,1) and events are [pause, move]. The move is applied after the game has paused.
expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick. The player should remain at (1,1) with no move event.
